chapters.title: Hear the overview
chapters.action: Select and start the direct spoken Mask.
chapters.result: Groceries. 2 things left · 1 completed Prepare lunch. Water plants. You can add an item.
chapters.why: The opening reports current list truth without reading every detail.
limitations: Selected WAV artifacts; zero speaker delivery and no attended human listening.

chapters.title: Read the remaining items
chapters.action: Request the current items through the spoken Mask reader.
chapters.result: Prepare lunch, item. Water plants, item.
chapters.why: Finite batches cover the remaining items once, in order.
chapters.next: Reencounter the list after the Owner stops.
limitations: Selected WAV artifacts; zero speaker delivery and no attended human listening.

chapters.title: Return to your list
chapters.intention: Keep the list across a fresh Owner Boot.
chapters.action: Restart the installed Owner and join from a new browser Host.
chapters.result: The same Body restores the exact committed state.
chapters.why: A new Boot verifies the checkpoint instead of trusting a remembered list.
